title: Narrative tense frames
subtitle: Use imperfect background and aorist foreground carefully.
overview: In narrative, imperfect forms often portray a setting or activity in progress, while aorist forms commonly present events as wholes. This is a reading pattern, not an iron rule.
Read the form together with lexical meaning, connectors, and surrounding clauses; aspect does not supply an English tense automatically.

sections.title: Narrative frame
rows: he said to them: speech event

items.grc: ἦν διδάσκων, καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος.
items.en: He was teaching, and the man came.
They were afraid, and he said to them.
